prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone wide 16:9 art-direction screen for PIRITORI, a 3D mobile isometric tactics game in underground Kallio, Helsinki, 2003. The attached runtime screenshot is ONLY a spatial layout reference: use its courtyard, arched passage, apartment facades, balconies, bikes, bins, low cover and six small figures. Completely redraw the rendering style from scratch. User wants decisively MORE STYLIZED than the reference, not a realism upgrade or a colour filter. Simplify surfaces and geometry to clear broad shapes, keep the fight board spacious and legible at wide battle zoom. Characters must stay low-detail temporary figures with very simple faces, no elaborate heroes or extra costume detail; simple Jade and Rust clothing distinguishes sides. Beautiful night, grit around3–4/10. Background architecture is painted; interactive cover, figures and minimal UI use simple cut-card shapes plus sparse imperfect marker marks. Do not make all scenery cardboard or bake interactive units into it. Deliver a plausible target for modular Blender meshes, small hand-painted textures, economical Three.js shading. Show no realistic microtexture, individual high-detail stones, dense bricks, ornate props or photorealistic glass. Minimal UI: just a thin charcoal bottom bar labelled 'ATTACK   MOVE   BRACE'; restrained cell outlines immediately near selected figures only. Preserve top-left room for the exact option label. No invented wall lettering, logos or additional narrative. OPTION04: PAINTED SHAPES. Broad gestural gouache masses, deep ultramarine/indigo courtyard, warm marigold light and faded turquoise facade planes. Architecture has slightly irregular hand-painted edges and enlarged simple windows, walls built from a small number of brush-stroke-shaped colour areas; discard all tiny texture detail. Wet paving reads as dark painted fields broken by a few large ragged brush-stroke reflections, not a grid of shiny stones. Simple volumetric geometry under matte painted textures, edges vanish into blue night in places. Figures and bins should read as a handful of coloured paper-like planes, not rounded plastic mannequins. Strong purposeful painterly stylization, adult street-noir rather than cute craft. Exact top-left label '04 — PAINTED SHAPES'.
